team.title: Team {name}
team.descriptionAdmin: Invite people to work with you: lists, chats, campaigns and replies are shared. Admins also manage the team, credits, API keys and webhooks.
team.descriptionMember: The people you share lists, chats, campaigns and replies with. Only admins invite, change roles and remove.
team.removeBody: They lose access to the team right away. You can invite them again any time.
team.removeBullet1: They no longer see the team's lists, chats, campaigns and replies.
team.removeBullet2: What they created stays with the team.

forMe.title: Invitations for you
forMe.item: You were invited to the team {name}.

invitation.title: Join {name}
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to the team {name} as {role, select, admin {an admin} other {a member}}. The team's lists, chats, campaigns and replies will be shared with you.
invitation.failed: Could not answer the invitation. Try again.
invitation.invalidBody: The invitation expired, was already answered, or is for another address. You are signed in as {email}: if the invitation is for another email, sign in with that one. Otherwise ask for a new invitation.
